search_plan.description: Industries, role titles, and company types targeted from the aptitude profile before discovery.

notes.description: Search caveats: exclusions, closed listings, ATS/board limits hit, or constraint effects.

company.description: Exact employer name as shown in the job posting.

role.description: Exact job title from the posting.

url.description: Direct URL to the job posting or official careers listing page.

match_description.description: Explanation of why this role matches the aptitude profile, referencing specific skills, domains, or adjacent roles.

location.description: Job location as stated in the posting (if available).

match_signals.description: Explicit mappings between aptitude profile and job requirements.

confidence.description: Overall match confidence based on alignment strength.
